from pathlib import Path
import subprocess,json,hashlib
root=Path.cwd();s=root/'.local/step07-ci-prerequisites';before=subprocess.check_output(['git','show','32923f333667757528834956e8aa23e09f62861c:.github/workflows/ci.yml']);after=(root/'.github/workflows/ci.yml').read_bytes();(s/'workflow-before.yml').write_bytes(before);(s/'workflow-after.yml').write_bytes(after)

 p=subprocess.run(['ruby','-ryaml','-rjson','-e','puts JSON.generate(YAML.load(STDIN.read))'],input=raw,capture_output=True);assert p.returncode==0;return json.loads(p.stdout)
